gaps.explanation: Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position - Proprietary Funds (p9 Electric, Sewer; p10 Natural Gas, Water, Allocated Administration, Total). JSON business-type receipts 6,445,231 = Total operating revenues 6,106,114 + Interest income 29,940 + Grant revenue (expense) 305,393 + Miscellaneous income 3,784. Added per column: Electric operating revenues 3,184,215; Sewer 505,345 and grant revenue (238,980); Natural Gas 1,790,916; Water 600,857 and grant revenue 540,954; Allocated Administration other revenue 24,781, interest income 29,940, grant revenue 3,419, miscellaneous income 3,784. Sum 6,445,231 = statement. Sewer's grant revenue (expense) is printed negative in that row and is added as printed (the JSON receipt line is the net Total 305,393).
